title: Spectacle Marks on Nose: Causes, Daily Care and What to Expect
ex: Why glasses leave dents and darker-looking patches on the nose, how a better frame fit helps, a gentle daily routine and realistic timelines.
rt: Spectacle Marks on Nose: Causes and Daily Care | Mirc Glow
rd: Spectacle marks on nose: why glasses leave dents and darker patches, and how frame fit, silicone pads, moisturiser and sunscreen help over time.
quick: Spectacle marks come from nose pads pressing and rubbing every day. Get your frame adjusted or switch to soft silicone pads, clean the pads daily, moisturise the sides of the nose and wear sunscreen. Darker-looking patches can take 8 to 12 weeks or longer to look softer.
facts: Pressure and friction cause most marks
Frame adjustment is the first step
Avoid lemon, baking soda and hard scrubbing
